args.question: I have found that Real-Time Session Efficiency (RTSE) is defined as the ratio of Content Interaction Efficiency (CIE) to Session Bounce Rate Adjustment (SBRA). I have also found the definition of Session Bounce Rate Adjustment (SBRA) in terms of the columns 'bncrate' and 'ctrval', but I could not find a definition of Content Interaction Efficiency (CIE). Can you provide a definition of CIE?

tool_trajectory.result: Content Interaction Efficiency (CIE) is a measure of how effectively users interact with content during a session. In this context, it is approximated by the average sequence value of interactions within a session, which can be seen as a proxy for the interaction flow.

args.sql:
WITH SessionMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        i.seshlink2 AS session_id,
        AVG(i.seqval) AS avg_seqval
    FROM 
        interactions i
    GROUP BY 
        i.seshlink2
),
BounceAdjustment AS (
    SELECT 
        s.seshkey AS session_id,
        s.bncrate * (1 - s.ctrval / 100.0) AS sbra
    FROM 
        sessions s
),
SessionEfficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.session_id,
        sm.avg_seqval AS cie,
        ba.sbra,
        CASE 
            WHEN ba.sbra = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE sm.avg_seqval / ba.sbra 
        END AS rtse
    FROM 
        SessionMetrics sm
    JOIN 
        BounceAdjustment ba ON sm.session_id = ba.session_id
)
SELECT 
    s.seshkey AS session_id,
    s.seshstart AS start_time,
    s.bncrate AS bounce_impact,
    sm.avg_seqval AS avg_sequence_value,
    se.rtse AS efficiency_score
FROM 
    sessions s
JOIN 
    SessionEfficiency se ON s.seshkey = se.session_id
JOIN
    SessionMetrics sm ON s.seshkey = sm.session_id;
